meta.purpose: Invented layout preview for Figure 10 (applicability boundaries); not experimental evidence.
meta.fixed_release: Yambda-Max at V5 with model and correction parameters frozen. Feedback is appended until the history doubles under FIFO eviction; every arm evolves its own state. Rebuild-once reconstructs at the start of the hold only. Anchors match the manuscript's synthetic Table 2 at V5.
meta.read_count: Net FLOPs saved by CacheTide relative to one reconstruction, as candidate reads per user per release vary at history 1,024 and 20 appends. Curves reuse the complete-FLOPs coefficients of ../e7_applicability/data.json for the two Max models.
meta.ledger_reads: Candidate reads per user per release in the Figure 6 ledger (20 appends with 11.5 scoring reads each).
